ThingDef.label: energy core I
ThingDef.description: Cuirass power source. Stores 100 energy and restores 6 energy per 60 ticks while the armor is worn. Uses one slot.

ThingDef.label: uranium reactor module
ThingDef.description: A fuel-powered reactor for a modular cuirass. Replaces the standard energy core. Stores 100 energy and generates 15 energy per 60 ticks while the cuirass is worn and fuel is available. Its internal fuel compartment holds 60 uranium. One uranium powers the reactor for one in-game hour. Uses one slot. Installation takes one in-game hour.

ThingDef.label: chemfuel reactor module
ThingDef.description: A fuel-powered reactor for a modular cuirass. Replaces the standard energy core. Stores 100 energy and generates 15 energy per 60 ticks while the cuirass is worn and fuel is available. Its internal fuel compartment holds 60 chemfuel. Two chemfuel power the reactor for one in-game hour. Uses one slot. Installation takes one in-game hour.

ThingDef.label: archotech reactor module
ThingDef.description: An exceptionally rare archotech energy source for a modular cuirass. Replaces the standard energy core. Stores 100 energy and generates 20 energy per 60 ticks while the cuirass is worn. Requires no fuel. Cannot be manufactured. Uses one slot. Installation takes one in-game hour.
